description: Ordinary FFmpeg library build: every built-in component and default libraries enabled. Only programs/doc/debug are removed. Answers: how big is a normal FFmpeg build?
notes: --disable-autodetect: no external libraries on ANY profile so the ladder compares FFmpeg's own feature set, not host-installed codecs.
--disable-x86asm: no nasm on the measurement host; applied uniformly to all profiles to keep the comparison fair.
